image_description: A close-up, low-angle view from inside a rustic wooden structure, likely an old-fashioned sawmill. In the immediate foreground, large, rough-hewn logs with bark are stacked horizontally. The mid-ground features heavy wooden beams, posts, and mechanical components including what appears to be a large circular saw blade assembly and drive belts/pulleys in shadow. The background shows an opening to the outdoors with natural light and greenery visible. The lighting is high-contrast, with deep shadows obscuring some details.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the bark on the foreground logs has a slightly repetitive, 'smudged' quality typical of AI generation, lacking the fine, crisp detail of real macro photography.
The mechanical components in the shadows (belts, wheels) lack clear logical connectivity. Some shapes seem to merge or float without clear axles or supports, suggesting structural ambiguity.
The transition between the dark interior and bright exterior has slight haloing and softness, indicating potential depth map errors or blending artifacts.
